Customer franchise and FINAI cross-sell; credit cost structurally moderating; FY27E/FY28E PAT ₹23,409 cr / ₹28,168 cr; ABV ₹212 / ₹252

23% loan growth, ROE 20-21%; stock already at 4.1x Mar-28 book, which caps upside

events.title: RBI stops eCOM and Insta EMI Card lending
events.detail: RBI barred new sanctions under the two digital products for not issuing key fact statements; lifted on 2-May-2024 after remedial action.

events.title: RBI raises risk weights on consumer credit to 125%
events.detail: Unsecured consumer loans of banks and NBFCs (ex housing, education, vehicle, gold) moved from 100% to 125%; bank loans to NBFCs +25pp. Feb-2025: the bank-to-NBFC increase was reversed from 1-Apr-2025; the 125% consumer-credit weight stayed (microfinance cut to 100%).

events.title: Bajaj Housing Finance lists
events.detail: IPO with ₹3,560 cr fresh issue; BFL sold shares in the offer for sale. BHFL remains a consolidated subsidiary.

events.title: 1:2 split and 4:1 bonus
events.detail: Face value ₹2 to ₹1, then four bonus shares for each share held: ten shares for one. Share count ~62 cr to ~622 cr; all per-share figures in this report are adjusted.
events.src: Screener.in (equity capital ₹124 cr at FV ₹2 in FY25 to ₹622 cr at FV ₹1 in FY26); q4ppt p23 (dividend 'adjusted for split and bonus')

events.title: MD Anup Saha resigns after four months
events.detail: Rajeev Jain re-designated Vice-Chairman and MD for the rest of his term to 31-Mar-2028.

events.title: BFL sells ~2% of BHFL in a block deal at ~₹97
events.detail: Part of the plan to bring BHFL to 25% public float; stake 86.70% by Mar/Jun-2026.

events.title: Accelerated ECL provision ₹1,406 cr and Labour Code charge ₹265 cr
events.detail: Booked in Q3FY26 'to enhance balance sheet resilience'; plus ₹142 cr overlay in Q4FY26. FY26 PAT before one-offs ₹20,689 cr vs reported ₹19,332 cr.

events.title: Q1FY27: PAT +28%, ROE 20.4%; ₹296 cr macro overlay
events.detail: AUM +24% to ₹5,46,944 cr; credit cost 1.54% (1.31% before overlay); guidance unchanged, to be reviewed after Q2.

events.title: RBI draft: NBFCs may offer only term loans (no revolving credit)
events.detail: Comments due 28-Aug-2026; only NBFCs authorised to issue credit cards exempt. Brokers estimate BFL's flexi (revolving) loans at ~13-15% of AUM (Jefferies ~14%, ~50bp extra yield). Stock fell ~6% on 7-Aug-2026. Final rule not issued by 30-Sep-2026.

events.title: Board to consider an equity raise (preferential issue and/or QIP)
events.detail: Notice of a board meeting at the start of October; no size given. Stock fell ~5% on 24-Sep-2026. Jefferies estimated ~₹15,000 cr. On the Q1 call (30-Jul) management had said it did not foresee raising capital and would dilute BHFL first.

revolvingCredit.status: Draft (6-Aug-2026), comments closed 28-Aug-2026; not final on 30-Sep-2026
revolvingCredit.exposure: ~13-15% of AUM per brokers (estimates conflict; one source ~25%)
